headline: What The FPL — Team Of The Week — GW6
body: The What The FPL Team of the Week for Gameweek 6! What is What The FPL? What The FPL is a website I'm running to predict and evaluate predictions around FPL. I've been posting my results and others' since last season. My model is based on historical data, odds and ML predictions. Over the past season it outperformed the likes of Fantasy Football Scout and the FPL team of the week picks. Since this season I'm tracking the accuracy of all free points predictor models to see which is best at whatthef.pl/evaluation . So far this season, What The FPL has been the best in it's category. Last week An very good week, scoring 57 points which was 9 points above the GW average. The Newcastle picks got clowned in the comments but hauled big. This week Some Everton assets to target the Hull City fixture. Saka captain against Leeds. No Haaland as the money is poured into Saka, Palmer, Mbeumo, Gabriel instead. Definitely a balsy team and not very template. Something New As you can see I also added something NEW to the website, which is a Wildcard team. It shows the optimal selection for 100m for the upcoming 5GWs, assuming you make no transfers. This might be interesting for those of you currently on Wildcard. In this team, there is (ofcourse) room for Haaland, while Gabriel is dropped. Mainly cheap options in defence that rotate well over the next 5GWs + Calafiori. Also, triple Fulham to target their favourable fixtures. Let me know if you have any feedback on this new feature!   submitted by   /u/WhatTheFPL [link]   [comments]
